Replace the overly strong single-ring identity (B_t cap G)/K = Ev by a fixed finite family of affine homomorphisms L_p from the source rho-fibre quotient to the target rho-fibre quotient. Unsafe v satisfy ybar in <L_p(v)>, a constant union of affine fibres.

construct maximal invariant separator of R excluding y by repeated SAFEEXT
SAFEEXT case 1: same-rho fibre -> fixed finite homomorphism-family avoidance -> polynomial decision+witness
SAFEEXT case 2: quotient-changing -> BMS post-extension localization -> defect-colour fibre -> original-bundle integrity -> one-bundle safe projection -> same-rho solver
maximal separator -> meet-irreducible -> remove dummy coordinates -> critical relation of sufficient essential arity -> parallelogram
intersect current C with separator; strict progress consumes compact/signature feature
after polynomially many critical conjuncts, obtain R = P_R_plus cap S_1 cap ... cap S_t
for each critical S: compute linkedness quotients; reduce nonreduced critical relation coordinatewise
apply Bulín–Kompatscher Theorem 4.6: construct A_12, fixed ternary graph relation Q, and lower-arity R'
map compact generators through the quotient homomorphism h so h(F_R) generates R'
